data.title: Initialize go spike contract
data.context: Build a living, source-grounded expert-council benchmark that synthesizes the engineering principles of Andrew Karpathy, Matt Pocock, Peter Steinberger, Rich Hickey, DHH, Simon Willison, and Mitchell Hashimoto into one context-weighted Guru Verdict with explicit disagreement clarification, temporal versioning, evidence confidence, hard gates, and actionable next moves.
data.decision: Use repo-local .go vision, principles, epics, tasks, evidence, and go auto loop for this project.
consequences: go auto can continue from repo state

data.title: Use source-grounded weighted council synthesis
data.context: The product combines public evidence about living experts into a reusable benchmark without impersonation or equal-vote false precision.
data.decision: Use immutable dated lens snapshots, context- and confidence-weighted median aggregation, explicit abstention, hard gates before scoring, and clarification for material disagreement.
consequences: Every evaluation must pin versions and provenance; unsupported claims fail closed; current and North Star scores remain distinct.
